Tourists walk straight to the beach. Locals know about this place.

The Cao Dai Temple on Đường Nguyễn Trãi is one of Phu Quoc's most visually striking buildings and most visitors never step inside. Bright colors, intricate detail, total quiet. A 10-minute stop that completely resets your day.

No entry fee. No crowds. Just show up respectfully dressed.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
